bpc-grand-island-ny.assessment: The Bible Presbyterian Church on Grand Island, New York is part of the Bible Presbyterian Church's Great Lakes Presbytery. Senior Pastor Dr. Kevin M. Backus holds a Ph.D. — unusually strong academic credentials for a small-denomination pastor. The BPC was formed in 1937 by Carl McIntire, J. Oliver Buswell, and Allan MacRae as a conservative fundamentalist-leaning breakaway Presbyterian denomination holding the Westminster Standards with a pronounced emphasis on biblical inerrancy and separation from liberalism. The denomination is very small (only 28 churches across the US and one in Canada) — MOOP readers considering BPC congregations should understand they will likely find a small, tight-knit, strongly-convictional Reformed fellowship rather than a large-church experience. Green-rated orthodox Reformed option for the Buffalo, NY metro.
